subject: MAP proposal and controlled testset exchange — RetailX pilot
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena@retailx.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: RetailX Legal <contracts@retailx.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: MAP & dataset exchange for pilot

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our product team was impressed with Redwood's latency profile and the autoscaling options. We're ready to move forward with a short pilot (6 weeks) that exercises retrieval + reranking and safety checks. To proceed we need a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a controlled exchange of evaluation material so our data science team can run acceptance testcases.

High-level asks from RetailX:
- Ephemeral access to a curated prompt pack and ~2k test cases (read-only, non-prod sandbox).
- Usage constraint: data cannot be used to fine-tune or to seed model training; logs may be kept for 30 days and then archived under our S3 tenancy.
- Automated takedown at the end of the pilot with proof of destruction / audit steps.
- Timing: we want the dataset available to our engineers by 2026-09-10 to hit a go/no-go on 2026-10-22.

I've attached a draft SOW that outlines scope and success criteria — legal has included a short list of redlines they anticipate. Can you send a MAP template and indicate whether Redwood can support ephemeral lanes + the takedown proof we asked for?

Attachments: RetailX_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF, 250KB)

Best,
Elena Ramos
Director, Product Partnerships
RetailX
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@retailx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & dataset exchange for pilot

Hi Elena — great to hear, and thanks for the clear ask. We can support an ephemeral sandbox lane with automated takedown and an audit manifest. I've attached our standard MAP template and a brief checklist that maps to your constraints. High-level responses below: 

- Ephemeral prompt pack & testcases: yes — we can host under a sandbox project and provide a signed attestation + S3 manifest at takedown.
- Usage constraints: we'll include contractual language preventing training/fine-tune use and will limit access keys to the sandbox compute + 30-day logs retention.
- Takedown proof: our ops team can provide a hashed manifest and a signed deletion log. If your legal wants an on-site audit we can discuss a paid audit slot.
- Timeline: we can aim to ingest and stage the material by 2026-09-09 if we receive the dataset by 2026-09-03.

Next steps I propose:
1) We sign the attached MAP (redwood_map_template_v1.docx) with RetailX's redlines applied.
2) RetailX shares the testcases via secure transfer (SFTP or temporary presigned S3).
3) We'll stage a handover runbook and schedule a 60-minute onboarding call with engineering.

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm the takedown attestation format (manifest + signed deletion log) and whether ops needs any additional gating for the S3 presigned approach?

Attachments: redwood_map_template_v1.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Karthik,

Looping you in on RetailX's pilot. They want ephemeral access to a 2k testcase basket + promptpack and a takedown audit at pilot end. RetailX target dates: dataset inbound by 2026-09-03, staging done by 2026-09-09, acceptance window closes 2026-10-22.

Immediate asks for ops/reliability:
- Confirm deletion attestation format: I prefer manifest CSV (filename, SHA256, size) plus a signed deletion log from the storage account.
- Will need a short-lived S3 presigned flow: generate tokens scoped to project:sandbox-retailx with 7-day validity.
- Add a canary ingest to validate KV cache behavior for reranking (sequence lengths will be long; suggest starting batch_size=8).

I've attached a quick manifest template and a suggested onboarding agenda. Can you confirm by EOD 2026-09-02 so I can commit the timeline to Elena?

Attachments: probe_basket_manifest.csv (CSV, 2KB)

Thanks — Priyom
From: RetailX Legal <contracts@retailx.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena@retailx.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & dataset exchange for pilot — redlines attached

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We've reviewed Redwood's MAP template and proposed language. Our counsel applied two modest redlines: explicit non-retention for training, and a short clause requiring proof of deletion within 14 days of takedown. We've attached the redline PDF for your legal team.

If Redwood can accept those points, RetailX will sign the MAP and push the dataset via our secure transfer tomorrow. We also confirmed HubSpot record RX-2026-017 should reflect a $0 pilot (evaluation only).

Attachments: redline_map_rx.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

Regards,
A. Collins
Contracts Manager, RetailX
